y: Anthropic observed_exposure ×100; estimated task-time and automation weights
matching: One Eloundou detailed occupation per six-digit SOC prefix, exact code match to Anthropic, and case-insensitive exact title agreement. No fuzzy-name matches or averaging across detailed occupations.

bins.rule: pandas.qcut, duplicates=drop; ties kept together; points are within-bin arithmetic means of x and y

weighting: Equal weight per matched occupation, including zero observed exposure
interpretation: Cross-sectional association. Anthropic incorporates Eloundou task feasibility; this is not independent validation. Different task weights and automation treatment mean y minus x is not an adoption gap.
